approach: Average speed is total distance divided by total time; find the time for each half from its distance and speed, then combine.

steps.text: Let the total distance be 2d, so each half of the journey covers distance d.
Find the time taken for each half from time = distance divided by speed.
Average speed is total distance over total time.
Cancel d and simplify to the standard form.

common_mistakes.text: Taking the plain arithmetic mean (v₁+v₂)/2, which is only correct when the two halves take equal time, not equal distance.
